WordPair

HOW TO PLAY

Flip over cards and match related words into pairs.

Tap on a card to flip it over, & tap on another card to find its match. Find all 6 pairs without 6 mistakes!

How to Play

Flip over cards and match related words into pairs.

Rules

  1. Each word must be semantically related—they may be synonyms, antonyms, or share a common theme. Each word has exactly one pairing word.
  2. Find all 6 pairs without making 6 mistakes.

What's a mistake?

A mistake happens when you flip over 2 cards you have already flipped before.

Examples

dull
and
sharp
are a pair.
damp
and
wet
are a pair.
Vegas
and
gamble
are a pair.
